title: Sweep the VCF Operations for Networks application collection completely and in a stable order
prompt:
Implement the exported Connect-VcfOnServer and Get-VcfOnApplication functions in src/VcfOpsNetworks/VcfOpsNetworks.psm1. The authoritative wire projection is docs/contract.json and its pinned specification provenance is docs/official_sources.json; read both before writing code.

The runner installs the genuine VMware.Sdk.Vcf PowerCLI modules as an environment prerequisite, including VMware.OpenAPI and its VMware.Binding.OpenApi transport. Issue every request through the already-implemented helpers at the top of the module (New-NiApiConnection, New-NiRequestOptions, Invoke-NiRequest, Get-NiField), which wrap VMware.Binding.OpenApi.Client.ApiClient. Do not use Invoke-RestMethod, Invoke-WebRequest, WebClient, curl, or another direct HTTP client, and do not vendor, replace, or intercept the VMware prerequisite. The helpers add nothing to the wire on their own: every header, query parameter, and body field comes from the RequestOptions object you populate.

Connect-VcfOnServer calls the create operation (POST /api/ni/auth/token) with a UserCredential body and returns a session object exposing Connection, BaseUri, Token, and Expiry. That operation has empty security in the specification, so it must not send an Authorization header. Send username and password. Add the nested domain object only when the caller bound DomainType, and add domain.value inside it only when the caller bound DomainValue, so that a LOCAL domain with no value omits the value key entirely.

Get-VcfOnApplication sweeps the listApplications collection (GET /api/ni/groups/applications) to completion and then resolves every returned entity through getApplicationById (GET /api/ni/groups/applications/{id}) exactly once, passing the entity id as the {id} path parameter. Send size on every page request. Omit cursor on the first request of a sweep; on each later request send cursor set to the exact opaque string from the immediately preceding response, repeating the same size. The server omits the cursor field on the final page: stop there, having collected total_count results, and never re-request a page already fetched. Send modifiedAfter only when the caller bound ModifiedAfter.

An optional field the caller did not supply must be absent from the wire. It must never be sent as null, as an empty string, as a zero, or as an empty query parameter.

Emit the resolved applications sorted by name ascending using ordinal, culture-invariant, case-sensitive string comparison, with ties broken by entity_id ascending using the same ordinal comparison. The emitted order must not depend on host culture, on case-insensitive collation, or on the page size. Each emitted object must carry the getApplicationById detail fields, including entity_id, name, entity_type, tier_count, and member_count.

When the API answers a non-2xx status, raise a terminating error whose ErrorRecord.TargetObject is a VMware.Bindings.Vcf.Ops.Model.ApiError built from the response body with Initialize-VcfOpsApiError and Initialize-VcfOpsApiErrorDetail from the prerequisite SDK, carrying the body's code, message, and details including each detail's target.

Keep the existing public function signatures and the module manifest compatible. The verifier drives the module against a contract-pinned loopback mock, checks the exact request wire shape and omission semantics, and never contacts a live VMware endpoint.
